scope: Production runtime adapter and durable manual command loop for scripts/accept-replay-workflow.cjs, checked without opening any UI, launching REPLAY or the fixture, or sending input. No APP-01 attempt is claimed or consumed.

productionMediaPath.method: The production createDeps().independentMediaVerification ran with the REPLAY checkout's own ffmpeg/ffprobe on a synthetic 840x1000 VP9 WebM source and H.264/AAC exports that imitate REPLAY's export graph (trim 1-7 s, box blur and filled callout at 1-3 s, one-second 440 Hz tone placed at 1.5 s). Each result then went through validateMeasurements.

productionTraceEvidencePath.method: The production createDeps().verifyTraceEvidence read one existing local TRACE session journal (2 completed actions) and verified its final observation PNG hash, read-only. The retained PNG was decoded at the same size used for the fixture texture measurement.

checks.cli: Child-process test: --plan is pure; --status, --advance and --live without an owner decision fail closed with a code and create no run directory.

foundAndFixed: Running the workflow file as the CLI loaded the runtime before module.exports existed (circular require); exports now precede the CLI block, with a regression test.
The loop read its idle clock after its first await; it now starts the idle window at entry.
limits: No live REPLAY, fixture, TRACE input or export ran. Readiness of the real fixture texture, capture, editing, playback and cleanup remains unproven until an owner-approved live run.
The synthetic exports imitate REPLAY's export graph; they are not REPLAY output.
TRACE evidence binding relies on the local TRACE journal written by the connected host; it does not prove semantic intent.
A live run needs .runtime helpers and the prepared fixture in the checkout it runs from (they exist only in the main checkout).
